title: Residential Tenancies Act
source_id: C.S.Nu., c.R-60 (originating as R.S.N.W.T. 1988, c.R-5, duplicated for Nunavut)
verified_how: Register page 'RESIDENTIAL TENANCIES ACT, Official Consolidation of', listed under R, legal notice last updated 13 December 2024. The notice PDF (NoticeCSNucR60.pdf) is headed 'Residential Tenancies Act / C.S.Nu.,c.R-60 / Notice under subsection 65(2) of the Legislation Act' and records changes 'made in the May 31, 2024 consolidation'. The consolidation PDF's cover prints 'OFFICIAL CONSOLIDATION OF RESIDENTIAL TENANCIES ACT / C.S.Nu.,c.R-60 / (Consolidation date: May 31, 2024) / R.S.N.W.T. 1988,c.R-5'. In force; not repealed; the Act's page carries no 'not up to date' warning.
notes: Carried-over NWT statute (R.S.N.W.T. 1988, c.R-5), duplicated for Nunavut under the Nunavut Act and since amended by Nunavut. Rent, deposits, repairs, termination and the Rental Officer's jurisdiction; it matters unusually much in Nunavut, where most housing is public or staff housing. The general consumer statute for the same topic is the Consumer Protection Act, verified on the same register as an 'Official Consolidation of' under C; only one Act is listed per topic and tenancy was chosen as the more consequential everyday statute.
